title: Track planner add-on
unavailable: The optional track planner is inactive. Track length and race speed also work without the add-on.
loadError: The add-on could not be loaded. Return to the track and check the installation.
installHelp: Install the separate add-on package locally, then enable it here. Disabling preserves saved plans.
speedHelp: Average of the last completed lap. Choose each driver’s selected car scale or the global setting. Cars without a valid scale use the global setting. A manually entered track length is sufficient.
lastLapSpeed: Average speed of the last lap
noLength: A valid track length is missing.
speedExplanation: Lap average based on {{length}} m · {{mode}}. Lane changes and pit routes make this approximate; this is not instantaneous speed.
standaloneHelp: Plans are saved on this computer. Exchange JSON, SBP or TRK files with RaceHubOS. No RaceHubOS installation is required.
standaloneMissing: Enter a name and at least one track piece.
